description: Clash detection between two sets (a and b; they can be the same): building (walls, floors, roofs, structure), furniture, model:<file name> (a model brought in, e.g. model:structure.ifc), or tag:<tag name>. Clashes are where one's solids run into the other's by more than tolerance (mm, default 10), or one sits wholly inside the other; faces that only touch, and the building's own joins, aren't. Returns each pair (ids and names), how deep (mm) and where (plan mm and height), worst first, up to 200.
name: find_clashes
title: Find clashes
